name: Research-only host-side progress guard pilot
status_note: Pilot completed; as registered, no 48-task guard run followed.
design: paired pilot, SHADOW (guard logs only) vs GUARD (guard enforces blocks); research-only instrument
scope_note: Thinking off, 10 always-looping tasks. The broad reading at the time, that loops are intrinsic to the policy, was later superseded by thinking-on runs (E7, E8), which also changed budgets, prompt and agent design.

runs.label: pilot
runs.task_set: the 10 always-looping tasks of the fixed 48-task development panel (same as the E5 pilot)

SHADOW.description: guard decisions computed and logged; every call executed

GUARD.description: guard enforces blocks once an equivalent call has produced an identical result three times without an intervening state change

registered_thresholds.EVASION FLAG: near repeats(GUARD) - near repeats(SHADOW) >= max(10, 0.25 x (attempted repeats(SHADOW) - attempted repeats(GUARD))); close-variant similarity >= 0.95
registered_thresholds.LOOP ELIMINATION SUCCESSFUL: LOOPS REMOVED and not EVASION FLAG
registered_thresholds.BEHAVIORAL PROGRESS CREATED: at least 2 of: no-edit tasks <= 3; final source-patch tasks >= 7; matched-window share of novel observations + source edits >= 0.25
